<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<profile xmlns="http://www.suse.com/1.0/yast2ns" xmlns:config="http://www.suse.com/1.0/configns">
  <general><mode><confirm config:type="boolean">false</confirm></mode></general>
  <language><language>en_US</language></language>
  <keyboard><keymap>english-us</keymap></keyboard>
  <timezone><hwclock>UTC</hwclock><timezone>Etc/UTC</timezone></timezone>
  {{slot:partition}}
  {{slot:network}}
  <users config:type="list">
    <user><username>root</username><user_password>!</user_password><encrypted config:type="boolean">true</encrypted></user>
    <user>
      {{slot:account}}
      {{slot:sshkey}}
    </user>
  </users>
  <software>
    <packages config:type="list">
      <package>curl</package>
      <package>systemd</package>
      <package>openssh</package>
      {{slot:packages}}
    </packages>
  </software>
  <services-manager><services><enable config:type="list"><service>sshd</service></enable></services></services-manager>
  <scripts>
    <chroot-scripts config:type="list">
      <script>
        <filename>lober-stage.sh</filename>
        <interpreter>shell</interpreter>
        <chrooted config:type="boolean">false</chrooted>
        <source><![CDATA[
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
{{lober:firstboot}}
{{lober:cleanup}}
]]></source>
      </script>
    </chroot-scripts>
  </scripts>
</profile>

Templates.Name: lober:agama
lober:unattend
Templates.Body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<unattend xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:unattend" xmlns:wcm="http://schemas.microsoft.com/WMIConfig/2002/State">
  <!-- Edition is the actual media image index. AutoLogon is required for the ordered firstboot chain. -->
  <!-- Server 2016/2019 static profiles require a separately qualified runtime; current UTF8 helper ABI does not qualify them. -->
  <settings pass="windowsPE">
    <component name="Microsoft-Windows-International-Core-WinPE" processorArchitecture="amd64" publicKeyToken="31bf3856ad364e35" language="neutral" versionScope="nonSxS">
      <SetupUILanguage><UILanguage>en-US</UILanguage></SetupUILanguage><InputLocale>en-US</InputLocale><SystemLocale>en-US</SystemLocale><UILanguage>en-US</UILanguage><UserLocale>en-US</UserLocale>
    </component>
    <component name="Microsoft-Windows-Setup" processorArchitecture="amd64" publicKeyToken="31bf3856ad364e35" language="neutral" versionScope="nonSxS">
      <UserData><AcceptEula>true</AcceptEula></UserData>
      <RunSynchronous>
        <RunSynchronousCommand wcm:action="add"><Order>1</Order><Path>{{slot:partition@pre}}</Path></RunSynchronousCommand>
      </RunSynchronous>
      <ImageInstall><OSImage>
        <InstallFrom><MetaData wcm:action="add"><Key>/IMAGE/INDEX</Key><Value>{{param:edition}}</Value></MetaData></InstallFrom>
        <InstallTo><DiskID>0</DiskID><PartitionID>3</PartitionID></InstallTo>
        <WillShowUI>OnError</WillShowUI>
      </OSImage></ImageInstall>
    </component>
  </settings>
  <settings pass="specialize">
    <component name="Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Setup" processorArchitecture="amd64" publicKeyToken="31bf3856ad364e35" language="neutral" versionScope="nonSxS">
      {{slot:network}}
      <TimeZone>UTC</TimeZone>
    </component>
  </settings>
  <settings pass="oobeSystem">
    <component name="Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Setup" processorArchitecture="amd64" publicKeyToken="31bf3856ad364e35" language="neutral" versionScope="nonSxS">
      {{slot:account}}
      <OOBE><HideEULAPage>true</HideEULAPage><HideOnlineAccountScreens>true</HideOnlineAccountScreens><ProtectYourPC>3</ProtectYourPC></OOBE>
      <FirstLogonCommands>
        <SynchronousCommand wcm:action="add">
          <Order>1</Order>
          <CommandLine>cmd /d /c {{lober:firstboot}} && {{slot:configure@firstboot}} && {{lober:cleanup}}</CommandLine>
          <Description>Lober ordered first boot</Description>
        </SynchronousCommand>
      </FirstLogonCommands>
    </component>
  </settings>
</unattend>

Templates.Name: lober:esxi

Hooks.Name: lober:partition
Hooks.Description: Destructive whole-disk installation. Native firmware determines boot partitions.

Impls.Body:
zerombr
ignoredisk --only-use='{{param:disk}}'
clearpart --all --initlabel --disklabel=gpt --drives='{{param:disk}}'
%pre --interpreter=/bin/sh --erroronfail
set -eu
if test -d /sys/firmware/efi; then
    printf '%s\n' 'part /boot/efi --fstype=efi --size=600 --ondisk={{param:disk}}' > /tmp/lober-partition.ks
else
    printf '%s\n' 'part biosboot --fstype=biosboot --size=2 --ondisk={{param:disk}}' > /tmp/lober-partition.ks
fi
printf '%s\n' 'part /boot --fstype=xfs --size=1024 --ondisk={{param:disk}}' 'part / --fstype=xfs --size=8192 --grow --ondisk={{param:disk}}' >> /tmp/lober-partition.ks
%end
%include /tmp/lober-partition.ks

# partman-auto chooses the native BIOS/EFI atomic recipe.
d-i partman-auto/disk string /dev/{{param:disk}}
d-i partman-auto/method string regular
d-i partman-partitioning/default_label string gpt
d-i partman-partitioning/choose_label select gpt
d-i partman-auto/choose_recipe select atomic
d-i partman-lvm/device_remove_lvm boolean true
d-i partman-md/device_remove_md boolean true
d-i partman-partitioning/confirm_write_new_label boolean true
d-i partman/choose_partition select finish
d-i partman/confirm boolean true
d-i partman/confirm_nooverwrite boolean true
d-i grub-installer/bootdev string /dev/{{param:disk}}

storage:
  layout:
    name: direct
    match:
      path: '/dev/{{param:disk}}'
    ptable: gpt

<partitioning config:type="list">
  <drive>
    <device>/dev/{{param:disk}}</device>
    <disklabel>gpt</disklabel>
    <initialize config:type="boolean">true</initialize>
    <use>all</use>
    <partitions config:type="list">
      <partition><mount>/</mount><filesystem config:type="symbol">btrfs</filesystem><size>max</size></partition>
    </partitions>
  </drive>
</partitioning>

@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions DisableDelayedExpansion
wpeutil UpdateBootInfo
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
set "firmware="
for /f "tokens=3" %%F in ('reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control /v PEFirmwareType') do set "firmware=%%F"
if "%firmware%"=="0x2" goto uefi
if "%firmware%"=="0x1" goto bios
exit /b 65
:uefi
> X:\lober\partition.txt echo select disk %LOBER_PARAM_DISK_INDEX%
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo clean
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo convert gpt
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition efi size=260
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo format quick fs=fat32 label=System
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition msr size=16
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition primary
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo format quick fs=ntfs label=Windows
goto apply
:bios
> X:\lober\partition.txt echo select disk %LOBER_PARAM_DISK_INDEX%
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo clean
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo convert mbr
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition primary size=750
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo format quick fs=ntfs label=Recovery
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo set id=27
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition primary size=550
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo format quick fs=ntfs label=System
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo active
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo create partition primary
>> X:\lober\partition.txt echo format quick fs=ntfs label=Windows
:apply
diskpart /s X:\lober\partition.txt
exit /b %errorlevel%
install --firstdisk='{{param:disk}}' --overwritevmfs

Hooks.Name: lober:packages
Hooks.Description: Additional native packages, Windows Server features, or qualified individual ESXi VIB URLs.

Impls.Body: {{param:packages}}
d-i pkgsel/include string curl systemd openssh-server {{param:packages|join}}
- '{{param:packages}}'
<package>{{param:packages}}</package>
'{{param:packages}}',

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$features = $env:LOBER_PARAM_PACKAGES -split "`n"
$result = Install-WindowsFeature -Name $features -ErrorAction Stop
if (-not $result.Success) { throw 'Feature installation failed' }
# Reboot is deferred until the ordered firstboot chain has completed.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${LOBER_PARAM_PACKAGES:?individual qualified VIB URLs required}"
esxcli system maintenanceMode set --enable true
printf '%s\n' "$LOBER_PARAM_PACKAGES" | while IFS= read -r package; do
    esxcli software vib install --viburl="$package"
done
esxcli system maintenanceMode set --enable false

Impls.Body: user --name='{{param:username}}' --password='{{param:pwhash}}' --iscrypted --groups=wheel

username: '{{param:username}}'
password: '{{param:pwhash}}'

<username>{{param:username}}</username>
<user_password>{{param:pwhash}}</user_password>
<encrypted config:type="boolean">true</encrypted>

Hooks.Name: lober:sshkey
Hooks.Description: SSH public key access. Match username to the account hook. Windows requires OpenSSH Server; only Server 2025 is guaranteed by the content contract.

Impls.Body: sshkey --username='{{param:username}}' '{{param:key}}'

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME:?username required}"
: "${LOBER_PARAM_KEY:?SSH key required}"
entry=$(getent passwd "$LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME") || exit 67
IFS=: read -r name password uid gid gecos home shell <<EOF
$entry
EOF
[ "$name" = "$LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME" ] || exit 67
case "$home" in /*) ;; *) exit 67;; esac
umask 077
install -d -m 700 -o "$uid" -g "$gid" -- "$home/.ssh"
printf '%s\n' "$LOBER_PARAM_KEY" >> "$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chown "$uid:$gid" -- "$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
chmod 600 -- "$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon -R -- "$home/.ssh"; fi

ssh:
  install-server: true
  allow-pw: false
  authorized-keys:
    - '{{param:key}}'

<authorized_keys config:type="list">
  <listentry>{{param:key}}</listentry>
</authorized_keys>

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME:?username required}"
: "${LOBER_PARAM_KEY:?SSH key required}"
entry=$(getent passwd "$LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME") || exit 67

$entry
EOF
[ "$name" = "$LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME" ] || exit 67
case "$home" in /*) ;; *) exit 67;; esac
umask 077
install -d -m 700 -o "$uid" -g "$gid" -- "$home/.ssh"
printf '%s\n' "$LOBER_PARAM_KEY" >> "$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${LOBER_PARAM_KEY:?SSH key required}"
[ "$LOBER_PARAM_USERNAME" = root ] || exit 64
umask 077
mkdir -p /etc/ssh/keys-root
printf '%s\n' "$LOBER_PARAM_KEY" >> /etc/ssh/keys-root/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /etc/ssh/keys-root/authorized_keys
vim-cmd hostsvc/enable_ssh
vim-cmd hostsvc/start_ssh
/sbin/auto-backup.sh
